tools.name: mes_list_downtime_events
tools.description: Retrieve MES-logged downtime events (reason code, start/end time, duration) for a line and/or equipment within a time window, used to reconstruct a timeline around a breakdown.

tools.name: mes_get_production_order_execution
tools.description: Retrieve actual run data (order number, product, start/end time, actual quantity, scrap quantity) against a production order for a line within a time window.

tools.name: mes_get_shift_operator_log
tools.description: Retrieve shift and operator log entries (shift ID, operator ID, line, start/end time) for a line within a time window, used as contextual (non-causal) evidence.

tools.name: mes_list_quality_events
tools.description: Retrieve in-line quality flags/holds (order number, defect code, quantity affected, timestamp) for a line or order within a time window.
